D1A_headline.reading: Q_psi's training data is NOT proportionally starved relative to deployment -- if anything it saw a RICHER share of stolen-flag states (~12%) than the deployed policy actually encounters (~8%). This weakens a pure 'barely contained' story.
D1A_headline.but: the ABSOLUTE branch-pair count is small: 91 stolen-flag counterfactual pairs on pole B, across all 256 seeds combined. That is the entire signal available to learn a directional ranking preference in this regime.

D1B_headline.non_overlap: 0.745 (all-rows UCB) < 0.809 (home-only LCB) -- the improvement from excluding stolen states is real and does not overlap the reference CI
D1B_headline.cross_check: 0.823 matches D0's flat-category Q3 own_flag_home rate (0.830 [0.820,0.839]) closely, despite different conditioning -- internally consistent

interpretation_1_localized_off_support.premise_b_phase0_barely_contained_stolen: NOT SUPPORTED IN PROPORTION -- 12% training vs 8% deployment, proportionally enriched not starved
interpretation_1_localized_off_support.verdict: premise A holds, premise B does not hold as stated

interpretation_2_capacity_or_representat.premise_states_well_represented: AMBIGUOUS -- proportionally adequate (12%), but only 91 absolute branch examples across the entire 256-seed corpus for this specific pole
interpretation_2_capacity_or_representat.verdict: does not cleanly apply either -- 91 examples is a thin absolute count even at an adequate proportion

APPLYING_THE_PERMITTED_LADDER.interpretation_3_diffuse_interference: NOT SUPPORTED -- removing stolen states moves the aggregate substantially and the CIs do not overlap
APPLYING_THE_PERMITTED_LADDER.interpretation_4_unresolved: DOES NOT APPLY BY ITS OWN CRITERION -- the uncertainty is tight, not broad, in both D1A and D1B
APPLYING_THE_PERMITTED_LADDER.HONEST_CONCLUSION: the evidence does not sort cleanly into exactly one of the four pre-written buckets. The closest fit is a REFINED form of interpretation 1: the failure is ABSOLUTE-COUNT-thin (91 branch pairs) rather than PROPORTIONALLY-starved (12% vs 8% deployment). This is still a data-coverage explanation, but 'barely contained' as literally written is not the right description -- 'thinly populated in absolute terms, for a regime that appears to need many examples to learn reliably' is more accurate. The spec's own text anticipated four discrete outcomes; this reports the actual, more nuanced one rather than forcing a fit.

WHAT_THIS_ESTABLISHES: own_flag_stolen is the dominant driver of D0's worst-quartile Q_psi weakness, not a peripheral outlier: excluding it alone lifts the correct-rate from 0.709 to 0.823, near the 0.83-0.90 range every other D0 category showed
the remaining, non-stolen-flag aggregate (0.823) is consistent with an optimization/interference story: Q_psi mostly right, PPO not reliably preserving the signal
within own_flag_stolen specifically (0.215), Q_psi is confidently WRONG, not merely uncertain -- this is not explained by proportional starvation alone
WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH: why 91 examples was insufficient (could be absolute count, could be that this regime is harder to represent, could be both -- not distinguished by D1)
any successor method design -- none is authorized by this record
independent confirmation of the own_flag_stolen finding -- D1B is a follow-up on the SAME data D0 used to discover it
authorizes: nothing beyond what D1_SPEC_FROZEN.json already authorized. SPPPO V1 remains CLOSED. No training. Any successor requires a fresh prospective decision informed by, but not automated from, this record.
